messages:
Hannah Lee: Hey all  starting today! My laptop/dock arrived but the USB keyboard and USB headset I requested aren't in the box. Dock powers laptop fine but keyboard isn't lighting up when plugged in. Anyone know who handles missing peripherals and quick desk swaps? :wave:

IT - Omar: Welcome Hannah! Keyboard/headset shipments are handled by Logistics. Quick check on the keyboard: is it plugged into a USB-A port on the dock or into a USB hub? Some docks have a dedicated upstream port. Also try a different USB port on the dock and reboot the dock power.

Hannah Lee: Plugged into the front-left USB-A on the dock. Swapped to the rear port, still dark. Tried my personal USB keyboard and it works in the same port, so maybe the company keyboard is dead or battery (it's wired though).

Logistics Bot: Package RDW-223344 status: delivered -> left_at_reception, delivered_time=2026-03-02 15:12 PST. Contents: MacBook Pro, Dock, Keyboard (KBD-Redwood-73), Headset (HS-QuietPro). Please verify reception location or reply "CLAIM_MISSING" to open a missing-item claim.

People Ops - Jun: @Hannah sorry about that. Can you check reception and the bench? If not found, reply "CLAIM_MISSING" and Logistics will start an investigation. We can also arrange a temporary headset from Facilities.

Hannah Lee: Reception checked, nothing there. I also checked the box contents twice. Replying CLAIM_MISSING now.

Logistics Bot: CLAIM_MISSING received for RDW-223344. Initiating missing-item claim for items: Keyboard, Headset. Courier contacted for POD photo and driver notes. Expected claim update: 24-48 hours. In the meantime, can offer immediate spare: reply "SPARE_DESK" for office pickup or "SPARE_SHIP" to ship a spare to your home address.

Facilities - Kai: Hey Hannah, I have a wired keyboard and a USB headset at the facilities closet. I can drop them at your desk in ~20 mins if you're at HQ. If remote, IT can ship a loaner.

Hannah Lee: I'm in the SF office, SPARE_DESK please. Thanks Kai!

IT - Omar: For the keyboard not lighting: if it's a model with a removable cable, check the cable end for bent pins; sometimes the vendor ships with a loose connector. But since your personal keyboard works, likely the company unit is faulty. Keep the spare and we'll RMA the missing ones once Logistics completes the claim. Please open an IT ticket so we log asset tags when they arrive.

Hannah Lee: Ticket created: IT-33012 "Missing peripherals + keyboard not detected". Thanks everyone for the quick help :thumbsup:
